desc: Derive the visibility condition using top slopes s_i(y) = (H_i-y)/X_i, including why only earlier buildings can block and why equality means hidden.
Justify that the maximum critical height over all pairs is attained by adjacent pairs.
Implement the adjacent threshold scan with exact integer rational comparison.
Fix output formatting to match the sample checker: use double-style fixed 18-decimal output for nonnegative answers, keep `-1` exact, and verify all samples.
Test edge cases: N=1, threshold exactly 0, negative thresholds, very large coordinates/heights, and the provided samples.
